name: Kachari Ruins (Ruins of Kachari Rajbari)
description: Medieval ruins of the ancient Dimasa Kachari kingdom capital in Dimapur, featuring unique mushroom-domed sandstone pillars and V-shaped memorial stones elaborately carved with animals, birds and motifs. Protected by ASI; remnants of a pre-13th century kingdom later contested by Ahoms.
facts: Ancient capital of Dimasa Kachari kingdom before 13th century
Located near railway tracks opposite Circuit House

name: Dimapur Town
description: Largest city and commercial hub of Nagaland, known as the Gateway to Nagaland. Located on the Dhansiri River plains near the Assam border; main entry point with airport and railway station. Multi-ethnic commercial centre with markets, hotels and base for exploring the state.
facts: District headquarters and largest city in Nagaland
Only major airport and railway in the state

name: Nagaland Science Centre
description: Interactive science museum and educational centre behind Naga Shopping Arcade in Half Nagarjan, Dimapur. Features galleries on senses, children's corner, fun science, planetarium and science park. Established with NCSM support to promote scientific awareness.

name: NEZCC Stone Garden and North East Heritage Museum
description: North East Zone Cultural Centre complex near Dimapur Airport featuring a stone sculpture garden with 31 works by Indian artists, traditional morungs, amphitheatre and the North East Heritage Museum showcasing crafts and artefacts from eight northeastern states.
facts: About 3 km from railway station, near airport
Stone garden and museum open to public
Average footfall 20 daily, higher on weekends

name: Hong Kong Market
description: Bustling flea market in central Dimapur known for affordable imported clothing, footwear, electronics and daily goods from Myanmar, Thailand and China. Popular shopping destination for locals and tourists; evolved from Tibetan traders' stalls in the 1980s.

name: Green Park
description: Family-oriented park inside the State Horticulture Nursery at 4th Mile, Dimapur. Features greenery, boating, water zorbing, ziplining, kids' train and picnic spots. Popular local hangout and tourist attraction.

name: Heirloom Naga Centre
description: Creative hub near Seluphe Junction, Sovima Village area showcasing contemporary and traditional Naga crafts, brands, gallery, workshops and experiential tourism. Unites local artisan brands under one roof.
facts: Near Sovima, about 15 min from airport

name: Zhotomi Ce (Naga United Village)
description: Traditional Chakhesang Naga house and living museum of artist Veswuzo Phesao in Naga United Village area. Features classic Kunemeche architecture with carved wood, mithun heads, and cultural displays; recipient of Governor's Award.
facts: Wood carvings of warriors and symbols
